description: Generic multi-storey government office block, flat ink 3 px, cream walls, postal-red band and door, flat roof; no emblem, logo or lettering. 400 square, shown 260-420 px.
Small one-storey village post office, cream walls, red roof strip, a tiny red letter box beside the door, blank signboard. 400 square.
Five wide cream steps rising left to right with ink edges, each tread blank for a label the scene writes; bottom step at left. 1200x600.
Cream envelope with a postal-red flap line, flat ink 3 px. 400 square.
Postal-red passbook with a white rupee sign, flat ink 3 px. 400 square.
Desk name plate: ink outline, white blank face for the scene's lettering, postal-red base strip. 400x200.
White sheet with a sand header strip, grey placeholder lines and a folded corner; nothing official-looking, no emblem. 300x400.
Postal-red map pin with a white centre dot, ink outline. 120x160, base at the tip.
Flat ink mail plane, side view, cream body with a postal-red stripe. 400 square.
Ink mortarboard with a postal-red tassel. 400 square.
Open laptop, cream screen with ink code lines and a small gear. 400 square.
Stack of cream forms with a pencil on top, flat ink 3 px. 400 square.
Two cupped ink hands holding a small postal-red heart. 400 square.
